#!/bin/sh
# Generated by PanelAlpha from apps/express/panelalpha.yaml — do not edit.
# Platform: express (Express)
set -e

PA_PHASE="${PA_DEPLOY_PHASE:-upgrade}"

pa_step() { printf '[panelalpha] %s: %s\n' "$1" "$2" >&2; }
pa_skip() { printf '[panelalpha] %s: %s failed (optional, continuing)\n' "$1" "$2" >&2; }

if [ "$PA_PHASE" = "install" ]; then
  pa_step install 'wait-for-db'
  until nc -z db 3306; do sleep 1; done
fi

pa_step start 'serve'
exec node server.js


[2 log lines] answer
true
